fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes, with synchronized participant alignment, scene controls and NPC undressing. v0.35.2 corrects the live CumOverlays relink introduced in v0.35.1 so it now mirrors RaceMenu's own RelinkOverlay behavior: the current body vertex descriptor is copied and the body's NiSkinInstance is cloned for each Body [OvlN] instead of sharing the body's exact skin pointer. Overlay snapshots are retried while OStim has no valid full-body source, and are relinked again if the body skin changes while a scene settles. This applies to both local players and STR proxies in free-standing and physical-furniture scenes, while leaving PPA, scene anchors and OCum equip meshes unchanged.
